title: Eighty Percent
author: Sam Okafor, Grid Engineering
pages: Numbers. Each district we take back is a fifth of the city's load.

Four districts lit is eighty percent, and eighty percent is enough to push current up the ridge instead of letting it pull. Enough to back-feed the Wreck itself. Black-start the whole city into it at once.
If that hatch opens for anything, it will open for that.
